replies.Briefly, how do you perform a Principal: First, standardize your variables to have mean zero and unit variance. Second, compute the covariance matrix. Third, calculate eigenvalues and eigenvectors of that matrix. Fourth, order eigenvectors by largest eigenvalues. Fifth, project original data onto these principal components.
